name: Alert warn-batch flush (per-box spool)
note: Drains THIS box's warn spool (state/alert-warn-batch.jsonl) via bin/alert-warn-flush.sh (which runs bin/alert-digest.sh --warn-batch). The switch (flags/lane-off-alert-warn-flush, or flags/all-off) also stops the inline dead-man in bin/lib/alert-state.sh, because that path runs the same --warn-batch: while it is off NO warn is delivered from this box, the spool keeps growing and silently trims oldest-first at ALERT_WARN_BATCH_MAX (60). Clearing it delivers what is left on the next tick. tests/alert-warn-batch-cron-test.sh W9.
